token.name: Prediction Markets Run by AI Agents

notes: VerdictToken mints 1,000,000,000 VERDICT with 18 decimals once to msg.sender in its constructor, which takes no arguments. Transfers have no fee. Holders may burn their own tokens, and approved spenders may burn within their allowance. The token has no owner or additional minting. There are no application contracts. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
